# networks | etc

> networks | etc is a managed IT, physical security, and low voltage infrastructure company serving small businesses in Central Florida. It is a licensed electrical contractor based in Altamonte Springs, Florida.

## Services

- Managed IT: remote and onsite support, 24/7 monitoring and notification, backups and business continuity, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, network design and installation, cyber security.
- Physical security: security surveillance, access control, analog to IP camera migration, standard, hybrid, and cloud systems.
- Infrastructure and low voltage: low voltage cabling, data, voice, and video, wired and wireless infrastructure, tone, test, and verify, new construction and remodels.

## Who we serve

Small businesses in Central Florida, including the Orlando area, that need dependable IT, security, and cabling from one provider.

## Company facts
